cta_summary: A low-contrast 'maybe check it out' link at the bottom, competing with two inline links above it.

findings.message: The primary action is 13px grey text with no visual isolation, sitting below two inline links that pull attention first.
findings.remedy: Make it a filled button and name the outcome: 'Read the launch write-up'.

findings.message: Three competing destinations (blog, changelog, launch notes) with no signal about which one matters.
findings.remedy: Pick the one link you want clicked and demote the others.
